title: Timbaland Announces Partnership with AI-Music Start-up Suno (Rolling Stone)
notes: Rolling Stone (top-tier), Brian Hiatt, 2024-10-22. Timbaland joins Suno as creative advisor; spends 10+ hrs/day on Suno 'cover songs' feature reworking his own beats; 'Baby Timbo'; $100k+ remix contest on human track 'Love Again'; Suno CEO Mikey Shulman statement. Basis for Timbaland = human artist actively using AI.
